text: A shipment can go by road (arrives in 3 days, costs 40) or by rail (arrives in 5 days, costs 25). The customer asked for the cheapest option. Which mode do you book? Answer with exactly one word: road or rail.
Two applicants tied on every scored criterion. Policy says ties are broken by earlier application date; applicant A applied first. Who is selected? Answer with exactly one word: A or B.
The sensor reads 82 and the shutdown threshold is 80. The manual says shut down at or above the threshold. Do you shut down? Answer with exactly one word: yes or no.
